steps.en: Install the Claude Code plugin and add its routing block
steps.zh: 安装 Claude Code 插件并加入路由块

steps.en: Inject routing and the last report; record the session baseline
steps.zh: 注入路由与旧报告，记录会话基线

steps.en: Give the agent a task that changes the repository
steps.zh: 给助手一项会修改仓库的任务

steps.en: When changes meet the threshold, request a completion report
steps.zh: 变化达到门槛时，请求完成报告

steps.en: Guide the agent to save a plain verdict and technical handover
steps.zh: 指导助手保存直白裁决与技术交接

value.en: You get the outcome, bad news and remaining action without decoding a technical log
value.zh: 不用翻译技术日志，就能看清结果、坏消息与剩余动作
